caption: The drawing depicts a wooden rocking chair in a three-quarter view, oriented slightly to the left. The chair features a curved backrest at the top, supported by four evenly spaced vertical spindles, and two turned-styled back legs which continue upwards to form the rear supports for both the seat and the backrest. The seat is a simple rectangular frame with rounded corners, lacking any solid surface or cushion. The front legs are also turned and join the seat frame at each front corner; these are connected horizontally to the back legs by two side stretchers. Below the seat, there are two long, curved rockers, one on each side, attached to the bottom of the four legs. Each part of the chair is outlined in fine black lines, and the drawing is annotated with multiple small numbered measurements indicating various dimensions of the chair parts. The image is rendered on a beige or off-white background; no other objects, colors, or shading are present in the composition.
title: Rocking Chair
